name: REO First Person
author: RaccoonRecomp
description:
A first-person camera for the US release (SLUS-20765 v2.00). The camera sits in your character's eyes and follows the head, locked to the eyes of the picture that is drawn (also while running, walking, turning and stopping); wherever she faces (walking sideways or back, in a hit or a grab) it stays at her head, looking out of it where you look, and moves with her head: her own turns take at most 30 degrees a frame, so it glides with her head and does not jump on its own (through the game's quick turn it keeps its spot). While you aim it looks where you aim, so a shot hits the dot in the middle; with the 45 Auto and Mark's handgun it sits on the gun's sight line, so the sights line up on the dot (other weapons: from the eyes); a shot's recoil plays in the picture and the view holds still. The right stick turns the view and her with it, so she faces where you look, and looks up and down; the left stick walks her where you look (she turns to its way at most 30 degrees a frame) and never turns the view (the game sees the right stick centred and a press of it (R3) as no ad-lib: no ad-lib lines). Only the right stick turns the view: when the game turns her itself (a door, the d-pad, the quick turn, a hit) the view stays where you look; lowering the weapon, it keeps looking where you aimed. The camera's settings (each view's Forward / Back, Up / Down, Left / Right, Look Up / Down and Field of View) are shown in the camera window (F8) and under Configure, locked: you can see what the camera does, but not change it. F7 switches it off and on.

It needs the game's mod runtime and a game build with its own code sites (its patches.json: camera.freeze and the marks of the game frame, the pad mapper and the room's draw), which the program compiles in at the first preparation.

conflicts.reason: both drive the game's camera: switch one of them off

settings.label: First Person
settings.description: On: the camera is in your character's eyes. Off: the game's own camera, exactly as without the mod.

settings.label: On / Off Key
settings.description: F7 switches First Person off and on again while playing.

settings.label: Normal View: Forward / Back
settings.description: While you walk and stand. Moves the camera forward (+) or back (-), in game units (about 1 cm each). 0 = the eye spot (8 units in front of the eyes, measured for each character).

settings.label: Normal View: Up / Down
settings.description: While you walk and stand. Moves the camera up (+) or down (-), in game units (about 1 cm each). 0 = the eye spot (8 units in front of the eyes, measured for each character).

settings.label: Normal View: Left / Right
settings.description: While you walk and stand. Moves the camera to her right (+) or left (-), in game units (about 1 cm each). 0 = the eye spot (8 units in front of the eyes, measured for each character).

settings.label: Normal View: Look Up / Down
settings.description: While you walk and stand. Turns the view up (+) or down (-), in degrees. 0 = level ahead (the head's view at rest).

settings.label: Normal View: Field of View
settings.description: While you walk and stand. The vertical field of view, in degrees. Starts at 63.

settings.label: Aiming View: Forward / Back
settings.description: While you aim. Moves the camera forward (+) or back (-), in game units (about 1 cm each). 0 = the same eye spot as the normal view; the view looks from there where you aim (with the 45 Auto and Mark's handgun the camera steps from there onto the gun's sight line).

settings.label: Aiming View: Up / Down
settings.description: While you aim. Moves the camera up (+) or down (-), in game units (about 1 cm each). 0 = the same eye spot as the normal view; the view looks from there where you aim (with the 45 Auto and Mark's handgun the camera steps from there onto the gun's sight line).

settings.label: Aiming View: Left / Right
settings.description: While you aim. Moves the camera to her right (+) or left (-), in game units (about 1 cm each). 0 = the same eye spot as the normal view; the view looks from there where you aim (with the 45 Auto and Mark's handgun the camera steps from there onto the gun's sight line).

settings.label: Aiming View: Look Up / Down
settings.description: While you aim. Turns the view up (+) or down (-), in degrees. 0 = where the shots go.

settings.label: Aiming View: Field of View
settings.description: While you aim. The vertical field of view, in degrees. Starts at 61.
